description: Formal pipeline eval over the real LangGraph planner, synthesizer, grounding, and critic nodes with deterministic synthetic retrieval fixtures.

results.label: embedding_model_and_dimension
results.answer:
DocChat uses the BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model, and the embeddings are 384-dimensional float32 vectors.
Sources: [PDF — architecture.pdf p.2]

results.label: pdf_ocr_fallback
results.answer:
When a scanned page has no embedded text, DocChat uses pytesseract OCR as a fallback to extract the text before chunking. The initial attempt to extract text is done using PyMuPDF, also imported as fitz.

Sources:
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.4]

results.label: pdf_chunking_parameters
results.answer:
PDF ingestion uses a chunk size of 1500 characters and an overlap of 200 characters.

Sources:
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.5]

results.label: youtube_transcript_library
results.answer:
YouTube ingestion fetches transcripts with youtube-transcript-api. Transcript segments are grouped into chunks of roughly 60 seconds before embedding and storage.

Sources:
[YouTube — DocChat ingestion demo @120s]

results.label: web_ingestion_libraries
results.answer:
Web ingestion uses httpx for sending HTTP requests and trafilatura for extracting article content.

Sources:
[Web — https://docs.example.com/web-ingestion]

results.label: agent_nodes
results.answer:
The five nodes in the LangGraph agent pipeline are: 
1. Planner 
2. Retriever 
3. Synthesizer 
4. Grounding 
5. Critic

Sources: [PDF — agent.pdf p.7]

results.label: chat_streaming_transport
results.answer:
Chat responses are streamed back to the browser using Server-Sent Events, allowing users to see words arrive incrementally.
Sources: [YouTube — DocChat chat demo @240s]

results.label: conversation_folders
results.answer:
Users can create, rename, delete, and use conversation folders to group existing conversations.

Sources:
[Web — https://docs.example.com/folders]

results.label: multi_source_ingestion_libraries
results.answer:
The libraries used for ingestion are as follows: 
For PDF ingestion, PyMuPDF (also imported as fitz) and pytesseract are used. 
For YouTube ingestion, youtube-transcript-api is used. 
For web ingestion, httpx and trafilatura are used.

Sources: 
[PDF — ingestion.pdf p.4], [YouTube — DocChat ingestion demo @120s], [Web — https://docs.example.com/web-ingestion]

results.label: unknown_information
results.answer: There is not enough information to determine what database migration tool DocChat uses.
